description: Update a meeting you organize: retitle, move, relocate, edit the description, or add/remove attendees. Moving only `start` keeps the meeting's length. It does not add a Microsoft Teams meeting unless you pass `teamsMeeting: true` (on an event that lacks one). Attendees are sent an updated invitation. Only the organizer can update a meeting — an attendee's edit would change their own copy alone, so it is refused. The result is verified by re-reading the event. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

end.description: New end. Omit when moving `start` to keep the current length.

id.description: Event Id from outlook_list_events or outlook_get_event

start.description: New start, ISO 8601 local time e.g. 2026-09-22T15:00:00

teamsMeeting.description: true adds a Microsoft Teams meeting to an event that lacks one (default false: the way people join is left as it is).

timeZone.description: Windows time-zone name for start/end. Defaults to the MAILBOX time zone.

name: outlook_update_event
